primary.title: Uber's Secure AI Framework Governs Autonomous AI Agents Across Their Lifecycle
primary.summary: In a recent article, Uber Engineering highlights the limitations of traditional identity and API controls in securing AI agents that dynamically reason over external content and take real-world actions. By Sergio De Simone

primary.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
primary.summary: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them appeared first on The Decoder.

By Bruno Couriol
